about: Questions with known answers for the simulated day in data/cnc_sim_data.csv (2 Nov 2026, Shift 1, V60 V61 V62). Built from assistant/fixture.py. 'expect' lists the values a correct answer must contain. Answerable questions name the lookup that holds the answer, so tests/test_assistant_testset.py can check the data side without the model. The Marathi and Hindi questions are a first draft and need checking by a native speaker.
